mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_space (space_id, space_name, space_type, description, status) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{spaceName}, #{spaceType}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.space_id, s.space_name, s.space_type, s.description, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, COUNT(d.doc_id) AS document_count FROM ai_knowledge_space s LEFT JOIN ai_knowledge_document d ON s.space_id = d.space_id AND d.status = 1 WHERE s.space_type = 'document' AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.space_id, s.space_name, s.space_type, s.description, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_document (doc_id, space_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, parse_status, chunk_count, vector_status, status) VALUES (#{docId}, #{spaceId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{parseStatus}, #{chunkCount}, #{vectorStatus}, #{status})
INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (chunk_id, doc_id, space_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, metadata_json) VALUES (#{chunkId}, #{docId}, #{spaceId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkText}, #{metadataJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, vector_status = #{vectorStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, space_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, parse_status, chunk_count, vector_status, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_knowledge_space WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND space_type = 'document'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_task_record (workspace_id, doc_id, mode, question, answer, rewritten_query, retrieval_scope, final_context, retrieved_chunks_json, retrieved_chunk_details_json, status, error_message) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{docId}, #{mode}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{rewrittenQuery}, #{retrievalScope}, #{finalContext}, #{retrievedChunksJson}, #{retrievedChunkDetailsJson}, #{status}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT doc_id FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND status = 1
